label: DAY 25
title: For 23 days I had 1 subscriber. Then one 50-second Short brought 4.

scenes.label: Subscribers (YouTube Studio)

lines.text: Four subscribers? You had one for three weeks.

lines: Studio says all four came from one Short.

scenes.title: Day 23 views, hours after it aired
lines: Three hundred ninety nine views in six hours.
Twenty two more in the next day. A burst, then flat.

scenes.title: How viewers found Day 23
lines: Ninety percent came from the Shorts feed.

scenes.title: Average % viewed, first hours (Studio)

lines.text: Same cartoon, though. Why did that one hit?

lines: It was the shortest. Fifty seconds.
People watched more than twice as much of it.

scenes.title: What I can't tell yet
lines: Not proven. It was also about me. One video isn't proof.

scenes.text: Prediction: this Short holds 30%+ in its first 5 hours
scenes.sub: Day 24 (1:22) held 20.3% in its first 5 hours
lines: So this one is short too. Under a minute.
If length matters, it holds over thirty percent.
Then it wasn't length. Do you skip long Shorts?
